name: Prompt templates
description: Your own slash commands: each template line becomes a /command that sends the filled-in prompt.
author: Mango

settings.label: Templates
settings.description: One per line: name: prompt. {{args}} is what you type after the command ({{args|fallback}} when you type nothing), {{project}} the project folder's name. \n starts a new line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
settings.default:
explain: Explain {{args|the code we just looked at}} step by step: what it does, why it is written this way, and anything surprising.
tests: Write tests for {{args|the code you just changed}}. Follow the project's existing test style, cover the edge cases, and run them.
review-diff: Review the uncommitted changes in this repository (git diff, staged and unstaged) for bugs, missing tests and unclear names. List the findings by severity and do not change any files. {{args}}
docs: Write or update the documentation for {{args|the code you just changed}}: doc comments where the code needs them, and the README if behaviour visible to users changed.
